$comment: Accepted production advisories for .github/scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry (max ~3 months); an expired entry fails CI so the risk is re-checked. Never add an entry that has a fix: upgrade instead.

advisories.reason: No fixed release (every version up to the latest, 4.0.7, is affected). ReDoS needs an attacker-chosen glob pattern. The wiki is a static site: picomatch runs only while Docusaurus builds or serves it locally (chokidar, micromatch), on glob patterns from this repository's own configuration, never on input from a visitor.
